one_liner: Ahrefs API v3 is a broad REST API with bearer API keys, but real access requires a paid plan (Lite $129/mo+); only free test queries are available otherwise. It has an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: API v3 uses bearer API keys created by workspace owners/admins (1-year lifetime). OAuth 2.0 auth code + PKCE exists via Ahrefs Connect, but it needs an approved app and production use requires an Enterprise plan, so API key is the primary method.
access_notes: API is included in paid plans from Lite ($129/mo). Free and Starter plans get only limited free test queries and some free public endpoints. Those test queries are usable for development, but full data access needs a paid plan.
blocker_notes: Meaningful API access needs a paid Ahrefs plan (Lite or higher). Free test queries allow limited development and testing. OAuth via Ahrefs Connect needs app approval, and production use needs Enterprise.

evidence.quote: send your API key as a bearer token in the `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` header. Free "public" endpoints do not require a key.
Note that only workspace owners and admins have access to this section.
Ahrefs Connect uses **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE)**.
Ahrefs API is available on [eligible paid plans](https://ahrefs.com/pricing). On all other plans, you'll still have access to a [limited set of free test queries]
API access is included in every Ahrefs plan from Lite up.
Production access requires an Ahrefs Enterprise plan; development and testing are free.
Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Site Audit, Rank Tracker, Brand Radar, Social Media, batch analysis, subscription info, and management endpoints.
Ahrefs provides a hosted MCP server that allows users with a Lite plan or higher to connect their Ahrefs account to supported AI tools.
